reviewed_evidence.title: Filter-only analyses now reproduced in OpenResearch
reviewed_evidence.finding: The new run reproduces the frozen downstream analyses. This establishes numerical repeatability from supplied analysis inputs, not independent EC accuracy, raw-spectrum reconstruction, or validated instrument sampling intervals.

reviewed_evidence.title: Earlier cohort RMSE rankings need qualification
reviewed_evidence.finding: The saved ftir_11 table gives lowest-OCEC 800 held-out RMSE 3.4148 on 194 test filters, while random 800 #3 gives 3.0971 on 154. Different test populations prevent a common-test ranking. PHASE3_SUMMARY documents the caveat; older build_notebooks.py takeaway text still overstates the RMSE comparison. Preserve that discrepancy rather than silently rewriting historical outputs.

reviewed_evidence.title: Spectral residual claim was qualified by paired evidence
reviewed_evidence.finding: For ftir_46 blocked spectra-beyond-metadata, pooled delta RMSE is -0.05957 with block-bootstrap interval [-0.13366, 0.02015]. With mass in the metadata baseline it is -0.12580 [-0.19869, -0.03223]. These are distinct comparisons; the first interval includes zero. Existing tables were inspected, not refitted here.

reviewed_evidence.title: Model-form results are recorded within their tested scope
reviewed_evidence.finding: The saved corrected lowest-OC/EC 800 table gives held-out predictive R² 0.90424 for PLS, 0.77299 for HGB, 0.73046 for RF, 0.52495 for MLP and 0.77096 for PLS-to-HGB. This supports the recorded comparison within that cohort, representation and protocol; it is not a universal model ranking. The README's approximate MLP lower endpoint of 0.53 is less precise than the table.

reviewed_evidence.title: Historical optical/filter joins need evidence recovery
reviewed_evidence.finding: The later audit identifies historical 15:00 bins labelled as 9 AM, limits of saved completeness, and a ±1-day candidate matcher. Keep older crossplots as historical diagnostics until underlying time and processing evidence supports a valid rematch. Source-code fixes alone do not repair stored pickles.

reviewed_evidence.title: Calibration-line blank correction supersedes pooled-lot interpretation
reviewed_evidence.finding: The phase-3 record states that ftir_47 keys blank fits by lot, intercept and slope, revising the earlier pooled-lot interpretation. Both per-line and pooled-lot ledgers are retained for review; no new blank fit was performed.

reviewed_evidence.title: Full VIBES/AIRSpec Colab comparison completed
reviewed_evidence.finding: 12,808 cases completed with zero failed fits. Full-pool held-out RMSE is 3.22438 for AIRSpec and 3.29581 for VIBES (2,327 filters). Restricted-cohort values are 2.54780 and 2.41985 (137 filters). Both original paired intervals include zero. This does not establish equivalence or permit comparing training cohorts with different test populations. The completion receipt and matching input bundle contents are verified by the local audit.

reviewed_evidence.title: Paired loading audit prioritizes a targeted spectral diagnosis
reviewed_evidence.finding: In the full-pool third training-defined loading quartile, (3.739, 6.994] µg/filter, VIBES increases RMSE by 0.45256 [0.18685, 0.74254] and MAE by 0.20892 across 545 filters at 30 sites. Higher VIBES MSE occurs at 23/30 sites; leaving each site out keeps delta RMSE positive. Both full-pool lot intervals include zero. These are exploratory pointwise results from 10,000 site-cluster draws, not a validated method-selection rule. Inspect BRIS1/CACR1 spectral discrepancies; keep independent Addis thermal validation and chemical-feature recovery as separate objectives.
